_note: Language word lists for normalize.py (a data file: no language lists in code). roman_urdu: words that only occur in untranslated Roman Urdu; English values never hold them. english: function words plus a few common ones, enough to tell Roman Urdu with some English mixed in from pure Roman Urdu; deliberately excludes proper nouns students use inside Urdu sentences (board, college names). rupee_words: how a currency field says rupees, normalized to PKR.
_rules_note: Audit #5/#7 rules, data not code. third_person: item fields written about the student or the person they belong to; first-person phrases (longest first) become third person. phrase_choice_types: an emitted value said as a phrase ("can't leave Lahore") reads as its catalog code. mobility: a quote says the student cannot move only when it holds a move cue, a place cue (these, the catalog provinces, or a city the turn names) and a negation. wish_cues: a family wish the extractor marks as the student's own statement (attribution.stated_field wish) is Stated only when the quote says a wish.
